name: Tailscale
description: Hold a Tailscale OAuth client so Paperclip can verify tailnet access and mint tagged auth keys server-side.

methods.whenToUse: Connect the tailnet that later Paperclip features will use for agent machines and sandboxes.
methods.guidanceMd: Create an OAuth client in [Tailscale trust credentials](https://login.tailscale.com/admin/settings/oauth) with the `auth_keys` scope (tags `tag:paperclip-agent` and `tag:paperclip-control`) and the `devices:core` scope, then paste its client ID and secret. Paperclip verifies the client server-side by listing devices and minting one short-lived ephemeral test key that it deletes immediately. The client never leaves the server.
methods.label: Tailscale OAuth client

credentialFields.label: OAuth client ID
credentialFields.helperMd: Copy the client ID shown after you create the OAuth client.

credentialFields.label: OAuth client secret
credentialFields.helperMd: The secret is shown once. It needs the `auth_keys` scope with the tags agents will carry and the `devices:core` scope. Paperclip cannot add scopes or tags to an existing client; create a new client and reconnect when access is insufficient.

tenantFields.label: Tailnet
tenantFields.helperMd: Keep `-` for the tailnet that owns the OAuth client, or enter the tailnet name such as `example.com` or `tail1234.ts.net`.

tenantFields.label: Agent tag
tenantFields.helperMd: Tag assigned to machines and sandboxes that join the tailnet for agents. The OAuth client must be allowed to assign it.

warnings: This version only verifies the OAuth client. Agents get no tools and no tailnet access from this connection yet; machine and sandbox access are separate, later features.
